title: Kolkata
sideASummary: Player deck back. No printed text.
sideBSummary: Kolkata, 22°34'22"N 88°21'50"E, code P2-19b. Regional map with a bullseye. The compass carries an anchor, so the city is a port. No search box. The city name and coordinates repeat upside down along the bottom.

rules: Black Player card for Kolkata. Port. No search box.
The bullseye in the map is the player-card upgrade slot. One sticker.
notes: The only Kolkata Player card. Goes to the reserve when the package is opened.
P2-01a says a recon from Kolkata may be possible, and that the team does not yet know how. This card does not print that route.
